The renewal date isn't settled: the sources give three different dates. I told Marcus in a #north-team thread to use 30 November 2026 for now and asked Ilse to confirm.

- **30 November 2026:** the signed 2025-26 renewal order form gives this as the end of the current term and calls it the renewal date. The Brackenwater account notes, last updated 30 September, say the same.
- **25 November:** Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 October. I found nothing that backs it up or explains the change.
- **31 December 2026:** a CRM note from 10 February says this, which doesn't match the contract either.

I only shared renewal dates, not prices or other money terms. Marcus owns the account and is on the North team, so he's allowed to see them.
